Change Super Admin Password

Only the password can be changed from this screen (changing the username is not supported at this time). Reaching this screen already requires being logged in as Super Admin, so the current password is not asked separately.

Office Hours Configuration

Late/Present and Overtime in Attendance are calculated automatically based on this time.

ZKTeco Access Control Device (Attendance)

For security reasons the browser cannot connect directly to a ZKTeco device (TCP port 4370). So a small "bridge/agent" program needs to run on any PC near the device -- this program reads the attendance log from the device and serves it on a local URL, and AccoFlow ERP pulls the data from that URL and adds it to HR > Attendance automatically. This feature is entirely optional -- nothing changes unless the toggle above is turned on.

The same Bot Token and Chat ID also need to go into the bridge's config.json (step-by-step in the README) -- the bridge sends attendance data to Telegram every few minutes, and AccoFlow ERP, even while hosted online, reads it straight from Telegram (HTTPS-to-HTTPS, so no Mixed-Content restriction).

To match each employee with the device, go to HR Module > Employees and put the device-registered user ID in that employee's "ZKTeco Device User ID" field (if left blank, matching by NID number is also used).

Supabase Integration

Enter your Supabase project's URL and Anon Key so data syncs across every device.

Online / Offline Mode

Online ☁️ mode uses the cloud Supabase. Offline 💻 mode uses a self-hosted (Docker) Supabase, so work can continue even with no internet (on the office LAN). Docker setup instructions are in docker/README_SELF_HOST.md.

OT Rate Settings

Every employee's OT Rate (৳/hour) is calculated automatically: (Basic Salary ÷ Standard Working Hours) × (OT Multiplier ÷ 100). Default values follow the Bangladesh Labour Act -- change if needed.
